title: AI orchestration policy (.github/ai-policy.yml)
description: Deterministic per-repository policy for the A.W.E. PR orchestrator. Runtime validation lives in scripts/lib/policy.js; this schema documents the contract and powers editor support.

echo_frequency.description: Timeline items between automatic status echoes at the bottom of the thread; 0 or null disables the automatic trigger (/ai status always echoes regardless)

authors.description: Exact GitHub logins whose PRs are automatically managed

humans.description: Humans who receive review requests and may opt PRs in

actors.description: Ordered reviewer identities; cross-vendor selection picks the first whose vendor differs from the PR author's

dedup_resolved_threads.description: Local-agent sweep: suppress a fresh finding that matches this actor's own prior thread at (roughly) the same spot; reopen (with a reply) an agent-only-resolved thread whose finding is re-detected. Only a thread whose resolver (GitHub's own resolvedBy) is a configured human is trusted and never auto-reopened — a human merely commenting earlier in the thread does not exempt it.

inject_review_history.description: Local-agent sweep: include this actor's own prior thread history in the reviewer prompt as a soft 'do not re-raise' hint, alongside the deterministic dedup_resolved_threads gate.

dedup_proximity_lines.description: Line-number tolerance for matching a fresh finding to an own prior thread on the same file (dedup_resolved_threads).

thread_authority.description: Who may resolve a review thread. 'fixer': today's behavior. 'adjudicate': the fixer still resolves, but the local-agent sweep re-adjudicates (withdraw/sustain/ask) any thread it pushed back on, instead of blindly re-raising. 'reviewer': the fixer never resolves; only the sweep resolves, always after re-verifying. Requires backends.reviewer to include local-agent when not 'fixer'. See docs/adr/0005-reviewer-owns-thread-lifecycle.md.

required_checks.description: Exact check names or /regex/ patterns; empty = all non-orchestrator checks

label_names.description: Optional state → display-label mapping (emoji-friendly); each value must be a non-empty, usable GitHub label name

prepr.description: Pre-PR refinement loop (LAW2 `refine`), consumed by the maintainer's private companion tooling, never by the PR-time orchestrator above.

reviewers.description: Roster ordered strongest first; first entry is the default reviewer

notify.description: Telegram ping on a terminal round reaching cap-reached or converged-with-a-dispute. Separate from notifications.telegram.enabled (the GitHub-side PR-time gate) — refine never touches GitHub.

allOf.description: Mirrors scripts/lib/policy.js's runtime check: the codex_actor fallback for reviewers.actors is always a cloud-Codex identity, which a local-agent sweep never runs as — a local-agent policy must configure reviewers.actors and reviewers.vendors explicitly (#290: reviewers.vendors has no fleet-specific default to fall back to).
